blurb: Guests board a Tiki-themed boat for a 1.5 hour cruise around Boston Harbor. The cruise features tropical décor, curated playlists, crafted cocktails, and views of Boston landmarks like the Bunker Hill Monument and USS Constitution. Public cruises have a laid-back island vibe, while private cruises allow guests to control the music and bring all ages.

quotes.text: A Front-Row Seat to Boston’s Sites Get up close and personal with Boston’s most iconic areas aboard our Tiki Boat cruise. Sail past the Bunker Hill Monument and the USS Constitution, and immerse yourself in the history near the Boston Tea Party Museum.

Every Cruise, a UniqueJourney Whether you’re a solo traveler or part of a group, Tiki Boat Boston offers memorable cruises for everyone. From tranquil mornings to dance-filled nights we have a cruise for every occasion.
